purpose: Prove the already released P0 First Customer Access path on the canonical REG.RU production contour: first restore the unique existing reviewer membership through one fixed owner-only exact-deployed command when unrelated main commits have advanced, then complete two independently authenticated public BFF registrations, configured transactional-mail acknowledgement, single-use email verification, server-side staff approval, ordinary login and MFA, server-resolved cabinet, a named permitted action, logout/re-login, and causal PostgreSQL audit/outbox plus tenant-isolation evidence.
requiredBehavior: run only from an owner-authenticated issue command on release issue 3072

allow the fixed prerequisite command /production p0-reviewer-membership-repair deployed-30d9075 only for exact already deployed revision 30d9075d8867fa60b3ec275b1e244f151debf0f4; arbitrary SHA input is forbidden

before and after the reviewer repair require both production API and Web OCI revisions to remain exactly 30d9075d8867fa60b3ec275b1e244f151debf0f4 and require that revision to remain an ancestor of repository main

the reviewer repair may call only the existing no-argument auth.repair_single_reviewer_membership function through pc_staff_runtime inside SERIALIZABLE execution and may change only the fixed internal organization, one reviewer membership, immutable staff audit and durable outbox evidence

the reviewer repair must not create or change identity, staff assignment, password, MFA factor, session, customer tenant, deployment, privilege, arbitrary SQL surface or recurring cost and must publish no PII, credential or raw database message
for the live customer journey resolve exact current main before every external action
use the public production Web BFF for registration, verification, login, MFA, logout and the permitted first action
require configured transactional-mail acknowledgement before email verification and never expose a raw email token in issue comments or artifacts
approve only through an existing server-authoritative staff reviewer session with recent MFA and STAFF_REQUEST_APPROVE permission

create two unique run-scoped public customer identities in distinct tenants; authenticate both, prove tenant A can read its own protected resource, then send tenant B through the same authenticated Web BFF against that known tenant-A resource and require the server-denied result

pair the BFF denial with a read-only PostgreSQL RLS assertion under the authenticated tenant-B session context: the known tenant-A resource must be visible to tenant A and invisible to tenant B; a generic 401, malformed request, nonexistent resource or application-only WHERE-clause rejection is not sufficient

bind audit and outbox proof to one named, server-authoritative P0 lifecycle action from this exact run: the correlation must match auth.registration.lifecycle.receipt and its registration-lifecycle idempotency key; no unrelated outbox row can satisfy the acceptance

return MISSING_P0_CAUSAL_OUTBOX_PRODUCER and fail the acceptance if the exact main does not yet produce that named lifecycle receipt; the acceptance workflow must not invent, insert or correlate a substitute event
fail closed when any protected reviewer or mailbox acceptance prerequisite is unavailable
redact credentials, bearer tokens, raw verification tokens, passwords, TOTP secrets and protected server paths
forbiddenCapabilities: direct VPS shell mutation outside the pinned owner-only workflow and its fixed exact-deployed reviewer prerequisite
direct production SQL to create, approve, activate or impersonate a customer identity
client-selected role, tenant or staff authority
demo, mock, localStorage or static-fallback authentication
runtime source rewriting, temporary generated production scripts or direct push from Actions
RLS, MFA, audit, outbox, CSRF or rate-limit weakening
new paid provider, SaaS subscription, API or recurring cost
reporting organization intake as proof of a user registration

exact API and Web OCI revisions equal exact main and public /ready remains healthy
public registration accepted only after mail transport reports delivery
email verification and status transition recorded server-side
separate staff actor approves with recent MFA and immutable audit
approved applicant logs in, completes MFA when required and reaches the server-resolved role cabinet
one permitted first action, logout and fresh login succeed
the named auth.registration.lifecycle.receipt outbox row, its registration-lifecycle idempotency key and the immutable audit entries match this run correlation
